description: 3D building 2013 (CityGML LOD2 model with textures) (archives) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Digital model of 3D LOD2 buildings with textures in CityGML and 3DM format of some boroughs of Montreal. The [digital terrain model (MNT)] ( of these districts is also available to present the complete digital model of the territory. This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate). Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are 3D, Building, Mockup, SIRR, Elevation. It offers 59 resource(s) in DXF, GML, HTML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
